Twisted Cord

You roll the fibers together until many small strands become something worth trusting.

Rules

- ID: recipe-twisted-cord - Permission: Trail Workshop, Make Something Useful or Enchanting Workshop; the recipe alone grants no crafting permission - Tools: Craft tools - Materials per attempt: Suitable long fibers, obtained in the scene or one compatible carried bundle use - Time per attempt: One hour - Result: Permanent item, target 4

Roll the crafting card’s attribute. Weak adds 1 progress; Standard 2; Strong 3. Accumulate progress until the printed target is met, then receive one finished product. Check carried material supply after each attempt. No group crafting.

@UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.2aca9936827b0c5b.JournalEntryPage.9c3708c89c713187]{Product}. This recipe can be one of the two ordinary choices granted by Trail Workshop or Ordinary Recipe Study. It is reusable and does not grant free ingredients.
